{{Vanilla|Mineshaft}}
A '''mineshaft''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its minecart chest loot, adding [[crystal heart]]s, [[The Book of Enoch]], [[raw diamond]]s, raw gold and iron, [[sulfur chunk]]s and the Gnocchi [[Cooking Recipe|cooking recipe]]. The [[Archaeologist]] sells Mineshaft Maps at level 1.
